name: input_revealable
title: Input Revealable
description: A password field with a button that shows or hides the password.

classes.name: input--revealable
classes.description: Shows an eye icon on the button. Use it with input and input--actor; leave the button's icon without an icon--* modifier.

classes.name: input--revealed
classes.description: Added while the password is visible; switches to the eye-off icon.

actions.name: reveal
actions.description: Switches the input type between password and text, and toggles input--revealed.
